note.text: Delivered signed main f43ee07d22d348c48a09131c2fc904cdf880c147; released Tiber 1.1.3 and Development System 10.0.5. Exact-SHA CI passed all required jobs: https://github.com/jwilger/ai-plugins/actions/runs/41703472733 . Both immutable release tags resolve to that commit. Independent final review is complete across six lenses, including two security samples; the causal failed-CI incident is resolved. Codex 0.166.0 filters ordinary SSH_AUTH_SOCK and treats env interpolation literally; portable plugin MCP cannot express env_vars. The installer now converges one complete shared user transport using native forwarding by variable name, an absolute trusted installed launcher and explicit plugin data; no new socket snapshot or key copy. Missing public-key authentication receives a static actionable redacted error. Existing unmanaged registrations are preserved. Full parent restart is required after agent rotation; rerun the marketplace installer after plugin upgrades. Verification: focused installer/agent 9/9; CLI 3/3 and MCP 8/8; actual Codex current/rotated/unset environment probe; separate real signed SSH fetch/push in two caller repositories; marketplace canary 1/1 and two distinct guidance cases 2/2. Installed both releases and applied shared repair on this account. Installed MCP task read succeeded in Ferrum without retaining private task contents. Fresh-data cold actual Codex startup registered 41 Tiber tools without model turns/auth copies; installed MCP read public HTTPS with SSH_AUTH_SOCK unset. The already-running conversation retains its old MCP connection and requires a full Codex restart from the current-agent shell. Reviewed all 16 queued task records and their actual board priority. Retained security-integrity and dependency-absence recovery first; placed the owner-requested, already-implemented code-navigation delivery third for low remaining cost and broad user value. Moved the rare large-review resource edge last as its admission rationale requires; retained all other relative priorities. Selected 20261006-imw4 as the highest-priority unblocked follow-up; implementation remains outside this completed authentication repair.
